guarantees.claim: end_of_block is 1 when (sent_message + 1) equals block_addr_limit; otherwise it is 0.

assumptions.claim: External logic must keep sent_message within [0, block_addr_limit] such that end_of_block can be asserted at the expected boundary.
assumptions.risk: If sent_message ever exceeds block_addr_limit, end_of_block will stay 0, potentially stalling the block termination logic indefinitely.

uncertain_points.claim: absorbed_d is declared as mubi4_t but not driven in this region; the SEC_CM comment suggests it should be a secure multi-bit control signal. It is unclear whether the driver ensures a valid mubi encoding.
uncertain_points.risk: If absorbed_d ever takes an invalid mubi value, it may bypass security-critical absorption control, leading to data leakage or integrity failure.
